lines.text: You file tasks fast, all day long. Quick thought, quick description, send it, next one.
But naming each one takes a moment you do not have. So you skip it, every single time.
By Friday your board is fifty cards called new task, and nobody knows which is which.
So you open each card to learn what it is. Open, read, close. Then do it again.
With auto titles, each task is named from its description the moment you create it.
There is no extra step. No field to fill, no button to press. You describe the work and move on.
A small language model does it inside your browser, so the text never leaves your device.
Now your board makes sense. Every card names its job, and you can scan it in seconds.
Search works too, because the words are there. Type checkout, and your task is found.
Your agents pick up a task that already says what the job is.
A readable board, without lifting a finger. That is the whole feature.
How messy is your task list right now? Be honest in the comments, and try auto titles at Agent R Q dot com.
